Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) – 8 USC §1101 et seq.
Title I: General provisions. §101: Definitions (alien, immigrant, nonimmigrant).
Title II: Immigration. Chapter 1: Selection system. §201: Worldwide level of immigration. §203: Preference allocation for family-sponsored and employment-based immigrants. §212: Inadmissible aliens (grounds of inadmissibility). §240: Removal proceedings.
Title III: Nationality. §301: Nationals and citizens at birth. §312: Naturalization requirements. §316: Residence requirements.
Title IV: Refugee assistance.
